text: There would be no more holy anger to be poured out on us. Jesus suffered the full price for our sin, so we don't suffer at all. Jesus paid for our sin in full. He absorbed in his flesh the holy anger, the righteous anger of God. So there's no more anger left for you. This is God addressing anger in a way that blesses you because you then become His son and His daughter. Augustine the early church.
